Server.Name: Area 7 Challenge
Server.Description:
Area 7 Challenge — A self-contained survival challenge mod for 7 Days to Die (V2.6)
You wake up inside a top-secret military research facility surrounded by lethal radiation. Your only goal: clear the facility, build an emergency transmitter, survive a blood moon horde, and escape to Camp Frilsville before the facility kills you.
Death is permanent. If you die, your run is over.
BLOOD MOONS:
Vanilla blood moons still occur on your normal cycle. The transmitter triggers an extra one — not a replacement.
FEATURES:
4-phase challenge tracked through the in-game challenge journal. Custom POI — a fully built military research facility with sleeper volumes, loot, and progression. Tiered airdrop system — your vehicle reward depends on how many magazines you've read. 8 themed zombie loot bag types (Medical, Heavy, Hazmat, Books, Police, Researcher, Biker, VIP). Custom crafting — Emergency Transmitter, simplified Car Battery, craftable Acid, Engine recipe. Permadeath system — lethal radiation zone prevents re-entry after death. Blood moon horde — triggered when you deploy the transmitter. Mission debrief — detailed HTML stats page generated after every run.
RECOMMENDED SETTINGS:
Air Drops: Disabled Loot Respawn: 5 days Biome Progression: Off
EAC must be disabled.
